building: Morgan J. Burke Boilermaker Aquatic Center

criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
evidence: Purdue GIS snapshot feature FID 896 is preserved as a raw source record; it is a building-specific footprint record.
R9 reopen validation compares the 70-vertex GIS ring with 70 structural-shell perimeter segments; maximum sampled bidirectional deviation is 0.000002 m.
The 2026-10-24 Arsee Engineers project photograph and its project listing identify the named aquatic center and support the natatorium program.
criteria.limitation: The extremely close local outline match is correspondence to the GIS polygon, not proof that the source polygon is a surveyed wall line.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
evidence: Coordinator-provided read-only master evidence reports Placement_morgan_j_burke_boilermaker_aquatic_center at (-808.6829834, 80.336998, 0), unit scale and zero rotation.
The manifest placement origin is (-808.683, 80.337); independently recomputing the stated XY difference gives 0.00001672 m, below the requested 0.00003 m tolerance.
The opened R9 shell object reports local dimensions [60.195, 102.504, 11.928] m; footprint correspondence provides the source-backed plan comparison.
criteria.limitation: The placement transform is coordinator-reported master evidence, not a master file independently opened by this evaluator. The manifest uses a local approximate geographic frame, not survey control.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: The saved source contains the named pitched-roof object and 21 schematic clear-span roof truss meshes; roof geometry remains present and visible after reopen.
The Arsee Engineers interior project photograph qualitatively supports exposed trusses and a high-bay pool hall.
The opened roof object reports local dimensions [60.908, 103.109, 3.0] m; no measured section or elevation source was supplied to validate those values.
criteria.limitation: Roof profile, truss member sizing and spacing, eave/ridge elevations, floor count, and total building height remain unverified. Dimensions read from the model are measurements of the model, not evidence for the real building.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
evidence: Street View source record supports a north brick facade, ribbon glazing, entry canopy, and building lettering; R8 north-entry and facade renders remain part of the R9 saved evidence set.
Arsee Engineers project photography supports the pool hall, Purdue wall lettering, metal bleacher banks, center aisle, and exposed roof structure.
The two R9 renders show continuous stepped aluminum bleacher tiers, riser plates, center aisle rails/posts, wall-mounted Purdue panels, pool/deck, and linear lighting.
criteria.limitation: Facade bay/opening dimensions, interior seating geometry, banner placement, rail compliance, fixture schedule, and truss detailing are not dimensioned/as-built evidence; the R9 cutaway view still presents a broad overhead plane with only limited readable roof structure.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: The reopened file uses the manifest's stable asset collection and asset path; the actual file SHA-256 matches both the R9 validation and R9 hash record.
The asset contains 1,129 objects, all mesh objects have materials, and it has no external image-file dependencies.
R9 source record lists provider, URLs, retrieval dates, source CRS/method where applicable, uncertainty, validation, and renders.
criteria.limitation: Some interior objects are explicitly schematic estimates, and the placement cross-check is supplied by the coordinator rather than included as independently inspectable master data in the asset folder.

master_placement_check.method: Direct marker transform comparison to manifest origin; no master file was opened or saved in this task.

evidence.score_basis: Evidence judged against the five AGENT.md rubric criteria. Unsupported roof/height claims are deducted; appearance alone is not treated as measurement evidence.

findings: The R9 asset and its recorded SHA-256 agree exactly: 136c7c7ee7d9d69f8bd1ac84e6e9269c00297a9c464bdd42ef13009bba66f497
The requested master marker comparison agrees with the manifest origin within 0.00003 m, closing the placement evidence gap from R8.
Roof and total-height accuracy remain uncertain: qualitative truss imagery supports the building type, but no measured roof/elevation record validates modeled roof profile or elevations.
The R9 model adds connected bleacher risers and aisle posts; exact seat/tread dimensions and accessibility compliance remain illustrative.
